title: Token DB: no ATR-based identification for PIV cards on generic readers
description: wp11_token_db.c matches tokens by USB VID/PID. A CAC/PIV card on a generic CCID reader (e.g., SCM SCR3310) is identified by the reader's VID/PID, not the card's. Lookup fails and falls back to generic PIV with WP11_QUIRK_SHORT_APDU, which caps response data at 256 bytes even for cards that support extended APDU. ATR-based identification (ISO 7816-3) would fix this. This is a design gap; filing as future work.
